label: DEVELOPMENT / SANITY MODEL - not the final evaluation policy
reward: reward_t = -(elapsed_wall_clock_seconds between decision t and observation t+1); gamma=1.0
simulator_assumptions: one decision = one request wave: each of `concurrency` workers completes one `chunk_size` request (or fails once and is retried)
per-request service time = latency + chunk_size / current_rate
current_rate = bandwidth until `switch_after` requests, then bandwidth_2 (request-count based, like the real SetRateAfter)
aggregate throughput per wave = bytes_wave / elapsed_wave
the simulator does NOT model the real downloader request/connection behavior; training conditions are NOT final evaluation conditions
